name: CalcuLoan – AI Guided Chat Loan Calculator for WordPress
author: bedebanks

sections.description:
CalcuLoan is a modern AI-guided loan calculator plugin for WordPress that helps financial institutions, lenders, credit unions, mortgage companies, microfinance organizations, fintech businesses, and financial advisors provide interactive loan calculations directly on their websites.

Unlike traditional static calculators, CalcuLoan delivers a conversational, chat-style experience that guides visitors step-by-step through loan calculations, repayment estimates, monthly installment checks, loan affordability insights, and borrowing decisions.

The plugin is designed to improve user engagement, simplify financial planning, and help website owners understand how visitors interact with loan products.

Whether you run a lending website, mortgage platform, credit service, cooperative society, fintech business, or financial advisory website, CalcuLoan helps your visitors estimate loan costs quickly and easily.

Key Features

  • AI-inspired chat calculator experience
  • Modern conversational loan journey
  • Personal loan calculations
  • Business loan calculations
  • Salary loan calculations
  • Asset financing calculations
  • School fees loan calculations
  • Custom loan products
  • Flexible interest calculations
  • Monthly repayment estimates
  • Loan duration calculations
  • Responsive mobile-friendly interface
  • Real-time calculation results
  • Admin dashboard overview
  • Calculation history tracking
  • Basic analytics and activity insights
  • Country and currency customization
  • Flexible proceed actions
  • Custom styling controls
  • Privacy-conscious settings
  • Shortcode support
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Works with modern WordPress themes

Who Is CalcuLoan For?

CalcuLoan is useful for:

  • Banks
  • Microfinance institutions
  • Mortgage providers
  • Credit unions
  • Cooperative societies
  • Fintech startups
  • Loan brokers
  • Financial advisors
  • Lending marketplaces
  • Investment platforms
  • Schools offering fee financing information
  • Businesses offering asset financing

Shortcodes

Use these shortcodes to display CalcuLoan on pages, posts, or supported template areas:

  • [calculoan]
  • [calculoan_calculator]
  • [calculoan_results]

About CalcuLoan Pro

CalcuLoan Pro is available as a completely separate plugin for site owners who need additional business-focused tools.

Pro features may include:

  • Advanced lead management
  • Advanced reports and exports
  • Enhanced analytics
  • Additional loan workflows
  • Floating calculator widget
  • Extended customization options
  • More business automation options

The free/core version remains fully functional and can be used independently without requiring the Pro plugin.

Learn more:

https://plugins.entitude.com/plugins/calculoan

Privacy

CalcuLoan does not connect to external services by default.

Any external URL configured by a site administrator, such as a proceed or redirect URL, is controlled by the website owner and is only used for the configured visitor action.

External Services

This free/core version does not require an external service to calculate loans or display the calculator.

If a site owner manually enters a third-party URL in the settings for a proceed/redirect action, that URL is controlled by the site owner.

Developer Notes

CalcuLoan is built for WordPress using standard plugin architecture, shortcodes, admin settings, and WordPress-compatible asset loading.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate CalcuLoan through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Go to the CalcuLoan menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Configure your loan products, currency, country, and calculator settings.
  5. Add the [calculoan] shortcode to any page or post.
  6. Visit the page and test the frontend chat-styled loan calculator.
sections.faq:
Does CalcuLoan require an AI API or external AI service?

No. CalcuLoan works independently and does not require an external AI API to calculate loans or display the chat-styled calculator.

Is the calculator really chat-styled?

Yes. CalcuLoan presents the loan journey in a guided, conversational format so visitors can move through the calculator step by step.

Can I customize loan types?

Yes. You can configure loan products such as Personal Loan, Business Loan, Salary Loan, Asset Loan, School Fees Loan, or custom loan categories.

Can I change the country and currency?

Yes. CalcuLoan includes country and currency configuration options so the calculator can match your market.

Does CalcuLoan work on mobile devices?

Yes. The frontend calculator is responsive and designed to work across desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.

Does CalcuLoan store calculation activity?

Yes. The plugin can record calculation activity and display useful dashboard and analytics insights.

Can I use CalcuLoan on multiple pages?

Yes. You can place the calculator on multiple pages using supported shortcodes.

Does the free version require a license key?

No. The free/core plugin is fully functional as a standalone plugin and does not require a license key, time limit, quota, or restricted built-in feature.

Can I redirect users after a calculation?

Yes. The settings include proceed action options so you can guide users after they view their estimate.

Is coding knowledge required?

No. CalcuLoan can be configured from the WordPress dashboard.
